description: This file defines the githubrestInterface class, which integrates a bug/issue tracking system with GitHub via REST API. It provides methods for connecting to GitHub, fetching issues, creating issues, adding notes, and generating URLs for bug tracking. It also handles configuration and connectivity status. The class extends issueTrackerInterface and interacts with external GitHub API libraries.

classes.name: githubrestInterface
classes.description: A class that provides an interface to GitHub issues for integration with a bug tracking system, including connection handling and issue management functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets up configuration, and establishes connection to GitHub.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration by setting default attributes and issue defaults based on provided configuration.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client instance used for GitHub interactions.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID has valid syntax (numeric).

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to GitHub API, verifying accessibility.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if connected to GitHub API.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL to view a specific issue on GitHub.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches and constructs a detailed issue object from GitHub.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose (readable) status of an issue, currently aliasing getIssueStatusCode.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the issue's summary as an HTML string.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Verifies whether an issue with the given ID exists on GitHub.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue on GitHub with the provided summary and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing GitHub issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template string for configuration of the GitHub integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Returns true indicating that issues can be created via the API.
